node.title: Arbitrary-arity support census and exact high-arity value at agreement k
node.statement: For every RS row, m>=1, and a>=k, the worst common-support m-interleaved list is at most binom(n,a). For every a, it is at least the ceiling of sum_{s>=a} binom(n,s)(q^m-1)^(n-s)/q^(m(n-k)), the exact received-word average. If q^m>binom(n,k+1), its exact value at a=k is binom(n,k).
